title: Stardew Valley Discs
description: This is a Minecraft resource pack that replaces Minecraft discs into Stardew Valley musics.
body:
**Main Purpose:** Replacing vanilla discs with Stardew Valley musics. For Stardew Fans!

- Replaced 16+ discs with stardew valley musics
- Best Played With https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/stardew-gui-pack

I'm totally new to all of this, I previously made it for my personal use, but now I present this to all of the true stardew fans. 

**_Note: This is a non-commercial fan-made resource pack created for Minecraft and Stardew Valley fans. I do not claim ownership of the original Stardew Valley music or any related intellectual property. All rights to the original music and assets belong to Concernedape. Musics in the content are taken from Stardew Valley OST_**
